rw01.name: Round rose-gold watch with mesh strap
rw01.description: Round-cased watch in a rose-gold tone with a mesh-style strap and a white dial with large numerals. Elegant and comfortable for everyday wear.
rw01.story: The round rose-gold case and mesh strap give it a modern, feminine air. The white dial with clear numerals makes the time readable at a glance. A versatile piece that works as well with casual looks as it does at the office.
highlights: Round case in a rose-gold tone

rw02.name: Square rose-gold watch with link bracelet
rw02.description: Square-cased watch in a rose-gold tone with a link bracelet. Available with a dark or white dial, so you can choose your style.
rw02.story: The square case and link bracelet give it a sophisticated character. It comes in two dial versions: dark, for dramatic contrast, or white, for a classic and luminous look. The same design, two personalities.
highlights: Square case in a rose-gold tone
Two dial options: dark or white

rw03.name: Gold-tone rectangular watch, choice of dial colors
rw03.description: Gold-tone rectangular watch with a link bracelet. Choose from five dial colors: white, green, blue, slate gray or black.
rw03.story: A classic gold-tone rectangular watch with a link bracelet that never goes out of style. Best of all, you can choose the dial that suits you most — from a sober white to a bolder blue or green. Each photo shows an available variant of the same model.
highlights: Rectangular case in a gold tone
Five dial colors: white, green, blue, slate gray and black

rw04.name: Round gold-tone watch with white dial
rw04.description: Round gold-tone watch with a white dial and large numerals. Gold-tone link bracelet.
rw04.story: With clean classic lines and a bright gold-tone finish, this round watch bets on the essentials: a clear white dial and large, easy-to-read numerals. A timeless piece that goes with everything.
highlights: Round case in a gold tone

rw05.name: Two-tone square-case watch
rw05.description: Square-cased watch with a date window: a silver version with a black dial, or a gold version with a silver dial.
rw05.story: The same square design in two color combinations: the silver version with a black dial, sober and modern, or the gold version with a silver dial, warm and luminous. Both have bar markers and a date window. Choose the one that best matches your accessories.
highlights: Two versions: silver with black dial / gold with silver dial

rw06.name: Digital sport watch
rw06.description: Digital sport watch in black and silver, with time display, alarm and timer.
rw06.story: Sporty in spirit with an octagonal case, this digital watch pairs black and silver with a metal link strap. The display shows the time in large figures, with alarm and timer functions in plain view. Ideal for the more active day-to-day.
highlights: Octagonal case in black and silver

st01.name: Silver-tone jewelry set with watch (5 pieces)
st01.description: A complete set in a silver tone: rectangular-cased watch, bracelet, pendant necklace, ring and earrings. Available with a white or green dial.
st01.story: Everything you need in a single set: an elegant silver-tone rectangular watch together with a matching bracelet, pendant necklace, ring and earrings. Available with a white or green dial. The perfect gift, ready to wear.
highlights: Includes 5 pieces: watch, bracelet, pendant necklace, ring and earrings
Two watch dial options: white or green

rw07.name: Silver-tone square watch with blue dial and date
rw07.description: Square watch with rounded corners in a silver tone, with a blue dial, date window and link bracelet.
rw07.story: A square case with soft corners and a blue dial with a satin sheen, on a silver-tone link bracelet. Understated, easy to read and with the date in view: it works as well with an office look as with a casual one.

rw08.name: Gold-tone square watch with silver dial and date
rw08.description: Square watch with rounded corners in a gold tone, with a silver dial, date window and gold-tone link bracelet.
rw08.story: A bright gold-tone case frames a satin-finish silver dial with slim hour markers and a date window. The gold-tone link bracelet completes a luminous piece that is easy to style.

rw09.name: Silver-tone square watch with gray dial and date
rw09.description: Square watch with rounded corners in a silver tone, with a dark gray dial, date window and link bracelet.
rw09.story: A dark gray satin-finish dial on a silver-tone case with soft corners, with slim hour markers and a date window. Discreet and elegant, made to be worn every day.
highlights: Dark gray dial with date window

rw10.name: Gold-tone oval bangle watch with Roman numerals
rw10.description: Oval-cased watch in a gold tone on an open rigid bangle, with a cream dial and Roman numerals.
rw10.story: An oval gold-tone case that seems to float on an open rigid bangle. The cream dial with Roman numerals gives it an antique-watch air, halfway between a watch and a piece of jewelry.
highlights: Oval case in a gold tone
Vintage air, between watch and jewelry

rw11.name: Gold-tone oval watch with dark gray dial
rw11.description: Oval-cased watch in a gold tone, with a dark gray dial with gold hands and a flat-link bracelet.
rw11.story: The gold-tone oval case and the dark gray dial with gold hands make a soft, elegant contrast. The flat-link bracelet keeps it light and comfortable for everyday wear.
highlights: Oval case in a gold tone
Dark gray dial with gold hands

rw12.name: Silver-tone oval watch with fine-link bracelet
rw12.description: Oval-cased watch in a silver tone, with a light silver dial and a fine-link bracelet.
rw12.story: A silver-tone oval case and a light dial with slim hour markers, on a fine-link bracelet that sits softly on the wrist. Delicate and easy to style.
highlights: Oval case in a silver tone
Light silver dial with slim markers

rw13.name: Silver-tone oval watch with thick bezel
rw13.description: Oval-cased watch in a silver tone with a bold bezel, a light silver dial and a link bracelet.
rw13.story: The thick bezel gives presence to the silver-tone oval case, which frames a clean, light dial. A simple piece with more character than a slim watch.
highlights: Oval case in a silver tone

rw14.name: Gold-tone oval watch with silver dial
rw14.description: Oval-cased watch in a gold tone, with a silver dial with gold hands and a gold-tone link bracelet.
rw14.story: The gold tone of the oval case and bracelet surrounds a light silver dial with gold hands. Warm, luminous and easy to wear by day and by night.
highlights: Oval case in a gold tone

rw15.name: Gold-tone rectangular watch with blue dial and numerals
rw15.description: Rectangular watch with beveled corners in a gold tone, with a blue dial, gold numerals and a link bracelet.
rw15.story: A gold-tone rectangular case with beveled corners and a deep blue dial with clear gold numerals. The gold-tone link bracelet completes a classic-looking watch with plenty of color.

rw16.name: Silver-tone rectangular watch with sage-green dial
rw16.description: Rectangular watch in a silver tone, with a sage-green dial, slim hour markers and a link bracelet.
rw16.story: A soft sage-green dial on a silver-tone rectangular case with a defined bezel. A discreet touch of color on a clean-lined watch.
highlights: Rectangular case in a silver tone

rw17.name: Silver-tone rectangular watch with white dial
rw17.description: Rectangular watch in a silver tone, with a white dial with slim hour markers and a link bracelet.
rw17.story: A clean white dial with slim hour markers inside a silver-tone rectangular case with a defined bezel. Essential, light and easy to style with anything.
highlights: Rectangular case in a silver tone
